app.name: senpi
app.one_liner: An experimental, opinionated fork of pi-mono that serves as a lightweight coding-agent runtime for Dori, Sisyphus Labs' AI assistant, incorporating select features from OMO while staying close to upstream.

screens.name: Main Agent Interface
screens.purpose: Primary TUI for interacting with the senpi coding agent, displaying agent output, tool calls, and task progress.

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Persist agent-generated artifacts or state snapshots to disk.

mvp_plan: week 1: Initialize minimal senpi runtime with core loop
week 1: Integrate builtin extensions from pi-extensions
acceptance_tests: Built-in extensions load correctly at runtime.
Core modifications remain minimal and tracked via changes.md.
The senpi CLI starts without crashing when packaged.
